note: A fragment inside a longer prophetic flow. Nothing added.
Justice Thomas named, which is the only checkable element; the colours and the unnamed woman are not. Pray for is not a prediction, so even the named part carries no stated outcome.
Clipped at the tips rather than cut off is a hedge inside the image itself: a partial constraint of any size satisfies it.

The substance is withheld on the grounds that it was bad and might put people in danger, with a promise to pray about releasing it. Same pattern as the ministries he could name and would not: the checkable part is asserted to exist and then not given.
Up by Damascus is a genuinely narrowing detail and improves the claim. But the fulfilment offered runs the wrong way: weapons being seized is the opposite of an attack occurring.
Addressed to an unnamed person about an unnamed condition, so nothing here can match or fail to match.
The twelve days is the only number in the passage and it belongs to a metaphor rather than to an event.
Next has no date. The ten million figure is roughly the island's whole population, so greatest harvest sets no threshold that could be measured against it.

Second time in this sweep he refuses to bank a near miss: drone attacks on Moscow happened and he says outright these are not the red tip missiles he saw. Worth recording as a counter-example. It also means the claim never expires, since the real version is always still to come.
The origin is given as last Sunday and sits inside this corpus, so the ordering can be settled. That ordering is what the whole claim turns on.
No date for the mark itself, and the consequence attached is one no earthly outcome could check.
Marked as belief rather than vision, which is the right hedge and rare here. The arithmetic is his own and does not add up: he says three years and then names a window that is two.
